newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade light - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade light - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area on Wednesday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt lower in light test. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 1,300 slaughter steers and 700 heifers; 85,500 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 18,100 formulated and 1,300 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 66.00.
Wk to Date - 85,500 Week ago - 63,000 Year ago - 65,500
